name: When no explicit finger numbers are given: if the phrase moves upwards, place the starting lower notes on fingers 1 or 2

then.description: When no explicit finger numbers are given: if the phrase moves upwards, place the starting lower notes on fingers 1 or 2 to reserve fingers 3-5 for higher notes. If the phrase moves downwards, place starting upper notes on fingers 4 or 5 to leave room for fingers 1-2.
